name: week
title: Security compliance this week
subtitle: Readiness, what needs attention, patches and leavers. Demo data is fictional.

sections.title: Readiness by framework
sections.note: Ready means implemented with current evidence.
sections.sql: select name as framework,target_date,days_to_target,applicable,implemented,ready,evidence_gaps,ready_pct from readiness order by target_date nulls last

sections.title: Patches past their Essential Eight window
sections.sql: select name,system,severity,rule,due_on,days_over from patch_status where status='open' and days_over>0 order by days_over desc

sections.title: Leavers who still have access
sections.sql: select person,end_date,system,access_level,days_after_leaving from offboarding where removed_on is null order by days_after_leaving desc

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: Every rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule,record,area,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,record

name: audit-ready
title: Audit readiness
subtitle: Controls, evidence, risks and the review calendar, for the run-up to an audit.

sections.title: Control gaps
sections.sql: select control_id,name,owner,status,evidence_state,frameworks from control_status where applicable and (status<>'implemented' or evidence_state in ('none','stale','expiring')) order by control_id

sections.title: Risk register
sections.sql: select name,owner,inherent,treatment,residual,review_on from risk_register where status='open' order by residual desc nulls first,inherent desc

sections.title: Review calendar
sections.sql: select kind,last_held,next_due,days_overdue from review_calendar order by next_due nulls first

sections.title: Suppliers
sections.sql: select name,criticality,data_access,assurance,assurance_until,next_assessment,state from vendor_status order by name
